Contract AirportSystem::createStaff(id: Integer,name: String,pswd: String,phone: String,role: Integer,bossid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		boss: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = bossid),
		isNew: Boolean = staff.oclIsNew()
	precondition:
		staff.oclIsUndefined() or
		(staff.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		boss.oclIsUndefined())
	postcondition:
		if isNew 
		then Staff.allInstance()->includes(staff) and
		staff.attriName = name and
		staff.Password = pswd and
		staff.Phone = phone and
		staff.Role = role and
		staff.Boss = boss 
		else result = staff.oclIsUndefined() 
		endif 
}
